selection_sets: Create, organize, rename, and recall persistent selection sets stored with the Maya scene.
quick_export: Export all selection sets immediately to the configured quick-transfer file.
quick_import: Import selection sets immediately from the configured quick-transfer file.
export: Choose a file and export all TheKeyMachine selection sets.
import: Choose a file and import its selection sets into the current scene.
clear_all: Delete every TheKeyMachine selection set from the current scene.
This action asks for confirmation before removing data.
